card.name: Words before 'to' after drug groups
card.fires_on: The word 'known' or 'likely' right after a noun like drugs, agents or patients, just before 'to' plus an effect (e.g. prolong QT). Also weakly on 'and' or 'or' in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Known/likely to
modes.description: 'known' or 'likely' after drugs, agents or patients, introducing an effect such as QT prolongation or altered metabolism.
modes.example: the use of foscarnet sodium Injection should be avoided in combination with agents<< known>> to prolong the QT interval including Class IA

modes.label: Joiner in contraindications
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' joining items in a contraindication or hypersensitivity list.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS: Vitafol ® One is contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to any of its components<< or>> color additives.

card.plain: It marks the word 'known' or 'likely' where a label describes drugs known to cause a particular effect.
